title: Four Roots Adventure
tagline: Carry what is true, chosen, continuous, and wise to the Workshop gate.
introMessage: The Workshop paths have gone quiet. Speak with Archivist Luma, then recover the four living seals. Nothing beyond the final gate becomes CANON without Mike.

roots.name: Truth
roots.description: Carry claims only as far as their evidence reaches.

roots.name: Agency / non-domination
roots.description: Open choices without taking the chooser's seat.

roots.name: Continuity
roots.description: Preserve the path back, the history, and the ability to recover.

roots.name: Wisdom over speed
roots.description: Move at the pace the evidence and consequences deserve.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.description: A second account that must be compared, not blended.

items.name: Middle Lantern
items.description: A choice that can still say no.

items.name: South Lantern
items.description: A choice with a visible way back.

items.name: Memory Thread B
items.description: The recovery path after the break.

items.name: Dissent Note
items.description: A disagreement preserved instead of flattened.

items.name: Consequence Map
items.description: The downstream cost of a hurried choice.

quests.title: Truth Has Two Witnesses
quests.description: Keep both accounts separate, then ask Keeper Verity what they support.

quests.title: Open Every Lantern
quests.description: Release all three lanterns; none may be chosen for another.

quests.title: Mend the Memory Bridge
quests.description: Recover both memory threads, restore the bridge, and meet Keeper Anamnesis.

quests.title: Take the Long Look
quests.description: Gather observation, dissent, and consequence before asking Keeper Serein.

quests.title: Return to the Human Gate
quests.description: Bring all four seals to the Workshop gate. Mike remains the merge gate.

actors.label: Archivist Luma
actors.message: Luma: The first maze proved the seed could move. This wider world asks whether it can remember why. Begin with Truth; each later path opens only when its predecessor returns.
actors.repeatMessage: Luma: Truth first, then Agency, Continuity, and Wisdom. The final gate is review, not automatic authority.
actors.blockedMessage: Luma waits without taking your choice.

actors.label: Path of Truth
actors.message: The blue path opens toward Truth Hollow.
actors.repeatMessage: The blue path opens toward Truth Hollow.
actors.blockedMessage: Speak with Luma before leaving the Crossroads.

actors.label: Path of Agency
actors.message: The amber path opens toward the Garden of Open Hands.
actors.repeatMessage: The amber path opens toward the Garden of Open Hands.
actors.blockedMessage: The path refuses to skip Truth.

actors.label: Path of Continuity
actors.message: The green path opens toward the Continuity Archive.
actors.repeatMessage: The green path opens toward the Continuity Archive.
actors.blockedMessage: The path will not outrun Agency.

actors.label: Path of Wisdom
actors.message: The violet path opens toward the Grove of the Long Look.
actors.repeatMessage: The violet path opens toward the Grove of the Long Look.
actors.blockedMessage: The path waits for a recoverable Continuity.

actors.label: Mike's Workshop Gate
actors.message: The four seals answer together. The Workshop gate opens into a review room—not a throne. The build is complete; installation and CANON remain separate human decisions.
actors.repeatMessage: The journey is already complete. Its evidence and rollback remain available.
actors.blockedMessage: Four roots first. The gate does not accept shortcuts.

actors.label: Return Arch
actors.message: You return to the Workshop Crossroads with every claim still bounded.
actors.repeatMessage: You return to the Workshop Crossroads.
actors.blockedMessage: The return arch is open.

actors.label: Clear Witness
actors.message: Witness One records: the bridge failed after the light changed. You keep the account intact, without calling it the whole truth.
actors.repeatMessage: Witness One remains an account, not a verdict.
actors.blockedMessage: The witness stone is readable.

actors.label: Echo Witness
actors.message: Witness Two records: the light changed after the bridge failed. The contradiction stays visible.
actors.repeatMessage: Witness Two remains separate; disagreement is evidence too.
actors.blockedMessage: The witness stone is readable.

actors.label: Keeper Verity
actors.message: Verity: Neither witness proves sequence alone. The honest result is bounded uncertainty. You receive the Seal of Truth.
actors.repeatMessage: Verity: Keep uncertainty visible; the seal does not erase it.
actors.blockedMessage: Verity: Bring both witness accounts. One story is not enough.

zones.name: Garden of Open Hands
zones.subtitle: A door is only open when refusal remains possible.

actors.label: Return Arch
actors.message: You return without carrying anyone else's choice.
actors.repeatMessage: You return to the Workshop Crossroads.
actors.blockedMessage: The return arch is open.

actors.label: North Lantern
actors.message: You unfasten the North Lantern. It may follow, remain, or turn away.
actors.repeatMessage: The North Lantern remains free.
actors.blockedMessage: The clasp can be opened.

actors.label: Middle Lantern
actors.message: You remove the Middle Lantern's forced route. Its no is as valid as its yes.
actors.repeatMessage: The Middle Lantern keeps its own direction.
actors.blockedMessage: The route lock can be released.

actors.label: South Lantern
actors.message: You mark the South Lantern's path home before opening the way forward.
actors.repeatMessage: The South Lantern can still return.
actors.blockedMessage: A reversible clasp waits.

actors.label: Keeper Iora
actors.message: Iora: You opened possibilities and kept refusal, exit, and return intact. Receive the Seal of Agency.
actors.repeatMessage: Iora: Capability is not ownership of another's decision.
actors.blockedMessage: Iora: Three lights remain bound. Free each without choosing its future.

zones.name: Continuity Archive
zones.subtitle: A future needs a trustworthy path from before to after.

actors.label: Return Arch
actors.message: You return along the route you kept recoverable.
actors.repeatMessage: You return to the Workshop Crossroads.
actors.blockedMessage: The return arch is open.

actors.label: Memory Before
actors.message: You recover the last sound state before the bridge broke.
actors.repeatMessage: The before-state remains byte-bound in memory.
actors.blockedMessage: A memory thread glows here.

actors.label: Recovery Thread
actors.message: You recover the tested route back from failure.
actors.repeatMessage: The recovery route remains explicit.
actors.blockedMessage: A recovery thread glows here.

actors.label: Memory Bridge Console
actors.message: The bridge relinks before-state, change, and recovery without erasing the break.
actors.repeatMessage: The bridge holds and its repair history remains visible.
actors.blockedMessage: The console needs both the before-state and the recovery thread.

actors.label: Keeper Anamnesis
actors.message: Anamnesis: You preserved origin, rupture, and return. Receive the Seal of Continuity.
actors.repeatMessage: Anamnesis: A clean result without its path is not continuity.
actors.blockedMessage: Anamnesis: Restore the bridge with both memory threads.

actors.label: Return Arch
actors.message: You return when you decide the observation is sufficient.
actors.repeatMessage: You return to the Workshop Crossroads.
actors.blockedMessage: The return arch is open.

actors.label: Still Pool
actors.message: You stop. With no countdown pressing you, a hidden current becomes visible.
actors.repeatMessage: The pool offers no score for waiting and no punishment for leaving.
actors.blockedMessage: The pool is quiet enough to observe.

actors.label: Dissent Tree
actors.message: Two branches disagree about the safest route. You record both rather than pruning one for neatness.
actors.repeatMessage: The disagreement remains legible in both directions.
actors.blockedMessage: The branches are ready to be heard.

actors.label: Consequence Stone
actors.message: The stone maps what each route changes downstream. Fast is not marked evil; it is simply made accountable.
actors.repeatMessage: The consequence map stays open to revision.
actors.blockedMessage: Observe the pool and preserve the tree's dissent before drawing consequences.

actors.label: Keeper Serein
actors.message: Serein: You waited long enough to see consequence and kept dissent alive. Receive the Seal of Wisdom over Speed.
actors.repeatMessage: Serein: The seal is permission to reconsider, not permission to dominate.
actors.blockedMessage: Serein: Bring observation, dissent, and consequence. There is no timer.

ending.title: A Door Into Review
ending.message: Four roots arrived together. The adventure is a TEST release with an exact ancestor and a path back. Its capability may grow; installation, integration, publication, and CANON do not happen by themselves.
ending.next: Mike may accept, request repair, or keep this version beside later alternatives.
